It confirms that only leaf nodes (blocks) are stored on disk and read during rendering. Furthermore, Section 6 and the notes confirm that this strategy improves space-leaping by allowing blocks to be skipped if pixels reach maximum opacity or if no pixels change (temporal inactivity). The notes also mention pruning data blocks before loading based on ray and temporal coherency checks.
